name: 裴重恩
objective:
This course introduces how satellites are designed, built, launched and operated. It covers the space environment, orbital mechanics and mission analysis, and systems engineering, including assembly, integration and test (AIT). It also covers the main subsystems: TT & C (telemetry, tracking and command), structures, attitude determination and control (ADCS), thermal control and power. A final unit covers cybersecurity and AI in satellite systems. Students run orbit simulations in NASA GMAT and write basic control software on a development board. They study real mission successes and failures and present a final report on a satellite mission or technology. Lectures are in English and use interactive quizzes, animations and case studies. The course is intended for graduate students and senior undergraduates in electro-optics, space science and related engineering fields.

本課程介紹衛星的設計、製造、發射與運作，涵蓋太空環境、軌道力學與任務分析、系統工程（含組裝、整合與測試 AIT），以及遙測追蹤指令、結構、姿態控制、熱控與電源等次系統，並探討衛星系統之資安與 AI。學生以 NASA GMAT 進行軌道模擬、在開發板上撰寫基礎控制程式，分析真實任務案例，並完成期末報告。全英語授課。
